A missing value is the absence its sentinel names.

source_time_system.basis: NDBC's measurement descriptions (faq/measdes.shtml): 'Times are in UTC'; the year, MM, DD, hh and mm columns
source_time_system.name: UTC

transformations: the year, MM, DD, hh and mm columns are read as one UTC instant (NDBC's measurement descriptions (faq/measdes.shtml): times are UTC)
the two-digit year 98 under a YY header is read as 1998: the YY layout is recorded only in a 1998 file, and the 2004 file writes YYYY (research-station-text F01); no other two-digit year is read
the header has no mm column, so the instant is read on the hour (minute 0)
a missing-value marker is an Absence carrying the marker as written
